answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 47891 Country: Pakistan Title: Eid-ul-azha Qurbani for people performing Hajj Question: For people who are performing hajj and they stay for more than 15 days in Makkah before Hajj days. Will their nisab for Eid al-Azha sacrifice be calculated based on the worth they have in Makkah or what they had in their own country? Answer ID: 47891 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1307/1286/N=10/1434) During the days of qurbani whatever wealth a muqim person has whether it is present with him that time or it is at home all shall be calculated in the nisab. ستفاد ذلك مما في رد المحتار (9:453 ط مكتبه زكريا ديوبند): له مال كثير غائب في يد مضاربه أو شريكه ومعه من الحجرين أو متاع البيت ما يضحي به تلزم اهـ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
